The Commodity Channel Index (CCI) is a technical analysis indicator that is used to help identify overbought and oversold conditions in financial markets. The CCI operator calculates the difference between the current price of an asset and its average price over a specified period of time. The CCI operator can be used on a variety of financial data, including stocks, commodities, and currencies. It is particularly useful in volatile markets where price fluctuations can be significant. Traders can use the CCI to identify potential buying and selling opportunities.                                                              
When the CCI value is above zero, it indicates that the asset is in an uptrend and when the CCI value is below zero, it indicates a downtrend. Traders can also look for divergences between the CCI and price movement to identify potential trend reversals.
